tools.name: local-lead-operations_record-normalize
tools.description: Copy supplied leads, calls, quotes, responses, and enquiries into a consistent inventory. Counts come from the request only. No CRM account is accessed. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/local-lead-operations/record-normalize. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: local-lead-operations_missed-call-analyze
tools.description: Identify missed calls and whether a later response was recorded for the same lead. Delays use supplied timestamps only. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/local-lead-operations/missed-call-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: local-lead-operations_response-delay-detect
tools.description: Calculate hours from enquiry received time to the first recorded response. Overdue uses the disclosed hour limit and does not claim conversion. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/local-lead-operations/response-delay-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: local-lead-operations_quote-followup-priority
tools.description: Rank leads with transparent rules for missed calls, response delays, and quotes without outcomes. Priority is not a prediction that a customer will convert. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/local-lead-operations/quote-followup-priority. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: local-lead-operations_unconverted-quote-detect
tools.description: Find quotes with no recorded outcome and age them from the sent timestamp. A missing outcome is not treated as a final loss. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/local-lead-operations/unconverted-quote-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: local-lead-operations_source-performance-analyze
tools.description: Calculate conversion rates from supplied source lead and converted counts. Ranking uses only sources that meet the disclosed sample minimum. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/local-lead-operations/source-performance-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: local-lead-operations_customer-enquiry-classify
tools.description: Classify enquiry text with transparent token rules such as emergency, quote, booking, or complaint. Classification is not a conversion prediction. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/local-lead-operations/customer-enquiry-classify. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: local-lead-operations_conversion-opportunity-report
tools.description: Combine unanswered missed calls, response delays, unconverted quotes, source rates, and enquiry classes from supplied records. No messages are sent and conversion is not claimed. Price $0.12 USDC. POST /api/v1/local-lead-operations/conversion-opportunity-report. An unpaid call returns the x402 payme
